rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jurjani points to the delicate effect of deletion and indefiniteness in the poetic phrase about a gaze and greetings along the road.
rows.anchor: وعرف لطف موقع الحذف والتنكير في قوله :

rows.speaker: البحتري
rows.claim: The phrase لي عليك دموع has an almost magical effect because لي precedes عليك and دموع is indefinite.
rows.anchor: وما في قول البحتري : ' لي عليك دموع ' من شبه السحر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He praises the line about stars rising auspiciously for its nobility, elevated level, and fine craftsmanship.
rows.anchor: وعرف كذلك شرف قوله : ( وقالت نجوم لو طلعن بأسعد )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Sensitivity to these literary distinctions is rare among people.
rows.anchor: والبلاء ، والداء العياء أن هذا الإحساس قليل في الناس

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A writer may produce a well-placed distinction in poetry or prose without knowing that he has succeeded, while remaining able to miss his own failures.
rows.anchor: حتى إنه ليكون أن يقع للرجل الشيء من هذه الفروق والوجوه في شعر يقوله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Only a person with responsive taste and a perceptive heart can be shown these subtleties; trying to explain them to someone who cannot see them is futile.
rows.anchor: حتى تظفر بمن له طبع إذا قدحته ورى ، وقلب إذا أريته رأى

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The danger is an ungifted person who believes himself qualified to judge and speaks foolishly; someone aware of his limits is rational and does not exceed them.
rows.anchor: إذا ظن العادم لها أنه أوتيها ، وأنه ممن يكمل للحكم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Thought cannot engage individual word meanings stripped of syntax: a verb is considered with a noun to govern, and a noun with a grammatical role such as subject, object, predicate, or modifier.
rows.anchor: لا يتصور أن يتعلق الفكر بمعاني الكلم أفرادا ومجردة من معاني النحو

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reordering قفا نبك into an arrangement that blocks grammatical relations leaves the reader unable to connect thought to any word's meaning.
rows.anchor: من نبك قفا حبيب ذكرى منزل ' ، ثم انظر هل يتعلق منك فكر بمعنى كلمة منها ؟

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He clarifies that thought can compare lexical meanings, but only after assigning the words syntactic functions suited to praise, blame, simile, or another aim.
rows.anchor: واعلم أني لست أقول إن الفكر لا يتعلق بمعاني الكلم المفردة أصلا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Bishr's simile shows that each phrase is conceived through its grammatical relation: annexation, attachment, coordination, predicate, and the clause describing the night.
rows.anchor: فخذ بيت بشار ، + الطويل + : ( كأن مثار النقع فوق رؤوسنا وأسيافنا ليل تهاوى كواكبه )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The narrative omits the objects of four actions: the people water their livestock, the women drive away their own flock, they say they will not water it, and Moses waters it for them.
rows.anchor: ففيها حذف مفعول في أربعة مواضع إذ المعنى : وجد عليه أمة من الناس يسقون أغنامهم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Leaving the objects unspoken keeps attention on the occurrence and agents of watering and driving away; the particular animals are irrelevant and naming them could misleadingly make the conduct itself seem objectionable only for sheep.
rows.anchor: وما ذاك إلا أن الغرض في أن يعلم أنه كان من الناس في تلك الحال سقي ، ومن المرأتين ذود

rows.speaker: البحتري
rows.claim: In the cited verse, omitting the object makes wasting and healing seem inherent in distance and closeness, a nuance impossible to preserve if the object is stated.
rows.anchor: قول البحتري ، + الطويل + : ( إذا بعدت أبلت وإن قربت شفت

words: إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْعُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Putting Allah before the scholars makes the point that the scholars alone among His servants are the ones who fear Him.
rows.anchor: علمت أن تقديم اسم الله تعالى إنما كان لأجل أن الغرض أن يبين الخاشون من هم

words: إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْعُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Reading the wording as though العلماء were fronted would instead identify Allah as the one feared, allowing others also to fear Him alongside other beings; that is not this verse's aim, though a related sense occurs elsewhere.
rows.anchor: ولا اللفظ بمحتمل له البتة

words: إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْعُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The contrast between ما ضرب زيدا إلا عمرو and ما ضرب عمرو إلا زيدا shows that the construction identifies either the agent or the patient, not both, and the two orders do not mean the same thing.
rows.anchor: ما ضرب زيدا إلا عمر و ، وما ضرب عمر و إلا زيدا

words: إِنَّمَا يَخْشَى ٱللَّهَ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْعُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Exclusivity applies to only one of the subject and object, and it falls on the element after إلا; it cannot affect the preceding element before the particle occurs.
rows.anchor: الاختصاص يقع في واحد من الفاعل والمفعول ، ولا يقع فيهما جميعا . ثم إنه يقع في الذي يكون بعد ' إلا ' منهما

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is mistaken to treat meter and rhyme as defects that lower speech merely because it is poetry.
rows.anchor: وإن زعم أنه ذم الشعر من حيث هو موزون مقفى ، حتى كأن الوزن عيب

rows.speaker: العلماء
rows.claim: The scholars say poetry is speech whose good is good and whose bad is bad; Jurjani notes that this maxim is also reported as a Prophetic marfuʿ report, without stating a grading.
rows.anchor: العلماء في قولهم : ' إنما الشعر كلام حسنه حسن وقبيحه قبيح ' ، وقد روي ذلك عن النبي مرفوعا أيضا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Even if meter can lead to singing and amusement, his advocacy of poetry concerns forceful diction, clear speech, apt representation, metaphor, allusion, and elevating or clarifying meaning.
rows.anchor: فإنا إذا كنا لم ندعه إلى الشعر من أجل ذلك ، وإنما دعوناه إلى اللفظ الجزل

words: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse cannot prohibit poetry for its eloquence, since that would mean God denied the Prophet البيان والبلاغة despite the scholars' agreement that he was the most eloquent Arab.
rows.anchor: وهذا هو الجواب لمتعلق إن تعلق بقوله تعالى : ( ﴿ وما علمناه الشعر وما ينبغي له ﴾ )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: If meter itself made speech blameworthy, blame should attach especially to its composer or seeker, not to someone reciting it for a different purpose; poetry cannot be disentangled from speech when recited.
rows.anchor: لكان من حق العيب فيه أن يكون على واضع الشعر أو من يريده لمكان الوزن

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Rhetorical merit is the completeness and beauty of speech's indication of its intended meaning, presented in a form that more powerfully attracts the hearer.
rows.anchor: غير وصف الكلام بحسن الدلالة وتمامها فيما له كانت دلالة ، ثم تبرجها

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Good expression approaches the meaning in its most accurate way and chooses the word most specific, revealing, and complete for it, thereby showing its merit.
rows.anchor: ولا جهة لاستعمال هذه الخصال غير أن يؤتى المعنى من الجهة التي هي أصح لتأديته

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Isolated words do not differ in semantic clarity for the thing they name; outside composition, distinctions are familiarity versus strangeness or lighter, more fluent sounds, as with ليث and أسد.
rows.anchor: أن تتفاضل الكلمتان المفردتان من غير أن ينظر إلى مكان تقعان فيه من التأليف والنظم

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In the question to Abraham, أأنت فعلت هذا presumes that the idol-breaking occurred and asks whether he was its agent; the answer likewise disputes attribution rather than occurrence.
rows.anchor: قولهم : ( ﴿ أأنت فعلت هذا ﴾ ) . وقال هو عليه السلام في الجواب : ( ﴿ بل فعله كبيرهم هذا ﴾ )

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The hamza in أفعلت asks about the act as something the addressee may or may not have done, while أأنت فعلت sets the act as evident and distinguishes its agent from others.
rows.anchor: فهو يقرره بالفعل من غير أن يردده بينه وبين غيره

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Another use of the hamza denies that an act happened at all, as in challenges to the polytheists' claims about sons and daughters for God.
rows.anchor: ولها مذهب آخر وهو أن يكون لإنكار أن يكون الفعل قد كان من أصله

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Fronting the subject directs denial at the alleged agent, as in asking whether someone said a poem; sometimes that form is used while the intended denial is that the act occurred at all, as with God's alleged permission.
rows.anchor: ومثاله قولك للرجل قد انتحل شعرا : أأنت قلت هذا الشعر

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: To arrange an utterance mentally is to assign ضرب as a predicate of Zayd, Amr as its object, Friday as its time, and discipline as its purpose; without these grammatical choices there is no arrangement.
rows.anchor: العاقل يرتب في نفسه ما يريد أن يتكلم به

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Words connect through the relations between their meanings, not merely as sounds; the joke of someone reading half a book depends on the lack of meaningful connection, as Abu Tammam's line indicates.
rows.anchor: لن يتصور أن يكون للفظة تعلق بلفظة أخرى من غير أن تعتبر حال معنى هذه مع معنى تلك

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A cited poetic example states the object of wishing explicitly because the point cannot be made without it; wishing to weep and producing contemplation instead are distinct acts, so the result cannot explain the wish's omitted object.
rows.anchor: فأظهر مفعول شئت ، ولم يقل : فلو شئت بكيت تفكرا لأجل أن له غرضا

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: In other cases, the object of wishing or intending may be omitted because the answer introduced by لو and its sisters supplies it.
rows.anchor: مفعول المشيئة والإرادة ، لأن الذي يأتي في جواب ' لو ' وأخواتها يدل عليه

rows.speaker: البحتري
rows.claim: In the Buthuri line, لك مثلا is omitted from قد طلبنا because the following clause لم نجد لك مثلا supplies it, and the omission adds subtle force.
rows.anchor: بيت البحتري ، + الخفيف + : ( قد طلبنا فلم نجد لك في السؤدد

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The poem is stronger when the explicit word مثلا receives the denial of existence; reversing the clauses leaves the denial on a pronoun, which never matches the direct expression.
rows.anchor: الأصل في المدح والغرض بالحقيقة هو نفي الوجود عن المثل .

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The image of the neighborhood's ravines flowing toward him gains its beauty from the original placement of the adverbials; rearranging them removes its sweetness and emotional effect.
rows.anchor: سالت عليه شعاب الحي حين دعا أنصاره بوجوه كالدنانير

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A passage may gain merit from wording, from composition, or from both; when both contribute, readers often wrongly credit the wording alone, and metaphorical merit may require understanding نظم.
rows.anchor: كلاما حسنه للفظ دون النظم ، وآخر حسنه للنظم دون اللفظ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The force of واشْتَعَلَ الرَّأْسُ شَيْبًا is not metaphor alone: the verb is predicated of something related to the true agent, شيبا, which follows in the accusative to clarify that relation.
rows.anchor: ولكن لأن سلك بالكلام طريق ما يسند الفعل فيه إلى الشيء ، وهو لما هو من سببه
